detailed_description: The Parallel Chart Generator helps you compare many dimensions of the same records in a single view. It is useful for spotting patterns, outliers, and similar profiles when a simple two-axis chart cannot capture enough variables. You can enter multi-column data, choose which dimensions to display, adjust labels and color options, and export the resulting chart as PNG or SVG after reviewing the live preview in the browser.
usage_steps: Paste or enter multi-column data so each row represents one record you want to compare.
Select the dimensions to display and arrange the axis order to match the pattern you want to inspect.
Adjust colors, labels, and line visibility settings to keep the chart readable.
Review the preview and reorder or trim dimensions if important differences are hard to see.
Export the final parallel chart as PNG or SVG for analysis notes, reports, or presentations.
usage_examples: Compare customer account attributes across spend, activity, retention, and satisfaction measures.
Review equipment readings across several operating dimensions to spot unusual combinations.
Analyze applicant profiles across score, experience, budget, and outcome fields in a hiring or intake review.
